summary: GoogleDeepMind released a patch update (0.1.1) to the SynthID-text library that removes requirements.txt in favor of pyproject.toml's deps property and adds permalinks to documentation.

practices.reason: Teams installing the SynthID-text package would need to adjust to the new pyproject.toml-based dependency declaration instead of requirements.txt.
practices.quote: Patch update to remove requirements.txt in favor of the `deps=` property in the pyproject.toml and update the README with permalinks to relevant articles, code, and examples.
